expectedUsable: The visual left-to-right order of the pricing tiers (Starter, Team, Enterprise) matches the DOM/tab/reading order, so keyboard and screen-reader users encounter the plans in the same sequence a sighted user sees.

violations.expectedFix: Reorder the DOM so tiers appear Starter, Team, Enterprise and remove the CSS `order` overrides (#tier-starter/#tier-team/#tier-enterprise), so visual order equals DOM order.
violations.notes: Visual order is Starter, Team, Enterprise via flexbox `order`, but DOM/tab order is Enterprise, Starter, Team. axe has no rule for CSS-induced order mismatch, so the page is clean.

violations.expectedFix: Ensure the programmatic reading sequence conveys the same meaning as the visual sequence (fixed by the same DOM reorder).
violations.notes: A screen-reader user hears Enterprise first, then Starter, then Team — the reverse of the visual emphasis, distorting the intended plan comparison.
